chapter_seo_title: Han Li’s Breakthrough: A Year in the Furnace Room | RMJI Chapter 215
chapter_meta_description: Han Li emerges from a year-long seclusion with a stockpile of Foundation Establishment Pills—and a breakthrough that shocks everyone. The quietest victory is still a victory.
og_title: Eleven Months, Twenty Pills, One Breakthrough
og_description: Han Li locks himself in a furnace room for nearly a year. He emerges as a Foundation Establishment cultivator with a pile of pills that would make any Qi Condensation disciple weep.
twitter_title: Han Li’s patience pays off—big time.
twitter_description: After nearly a year in a furnace room, Han Li walks out a Foundation Establishment cultivator. The system doesn’t reward talent. It rewards preparation.
